subject: CAIQ: sample capture plan and validation roadmap
messages:
From: Susan Leung <susan.leung@horizonfin.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@horizonfin.com
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ - request: control mapping + sample logs

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for walking us through the Dedicated offering yesterday. As part of our vendor assessment timeline we need a concise CAIQ mapping and a small set of runtime artifacts to validate a subset of controls (mainly CCM-09: Scheduled Operation, CCM-11: Identity & Access, CCM-15: Logging Telemetry).

Could you provide the following by next week (7/6)?
- A control-to-Redwood-responsibility matrix focusing on the three domains above (CSV or XLSX is fine)
- One or two short log samples showing request/response traces with redaction applied (anonymized KV cache reads, token-level latency summary)
- Owner names and SLAs for any controls mapped to Redwood (for our security team)

We can accept a Drive folder or a secure DocuSign/portal link for delivery. If you expect any of the items to be scoped out (e.g., on-prem private installs), call that out.

Cc'ing Alex from our external audit team so he can flag anything he needs for the pre-eval.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Susan

--
Susan Leung
Head of Vendor Risk, Horizon Financial
susan.leung@horizonfin.com

From: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Susan Leung <susan.leung@horizonfin.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Montgomery <alex.montgomery@auditfirm.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ - request: control mapping + sample logs

Hi Susan — thanks for the clear ask and for looping Alex in. We're on it. High-level plan below; details and artifacts will land in the Drive link (shared) by EOD 6/30 unless we need an extension.

Action plan (owners):
- Control matrix (CSV): Naomi (I will map Redwood controls to CAIQ claims and note where customer config applies). Expected deliverable: caiq_control_list.xlsx
- Log samples (anonymized): Marissa (will extract a short KV/cache access trace and a token-latency summary file). Deliverable: kv_cache_sample.log (redacted)
- Control owners & SLAs: Karthik (authoritative owners for infra/serving/runtime; will include on-call contact patterns and typical RTO/RPO statements).
- Evidence notes: short README for each artifact explaining how it maps to the CAIQ claim and any residual gaps to be covered by Horizon (if any).

Clarifications we need:
1) Do you want full request/response payloads or redacted extracts? Our default is redacted extracts + schema description to avoid PII.
2) For CCM-09 (operation scheduling) — is Horizon only interested in Hosted API behavior, or do you want Dedicated/Private deployment notes too?

I'll drop the Drive folder link when the package is ready. If Alex needs anything specific for audit sampling, reply-all with the items to prioritize.

Best,
Naomi
Director, Customer Security (Redwood Inference)
Attachments: (none yet)

Hi all — quick update and the artifacts. Attached: caiq_control_list.xlsx (control mapping + owner column) and kv_cache_sample.log (redacted). See short notes below.

Notes on artifacts:
- caiq_control_list.xlsx: includes a three-column view (CAIQ control id, Redwood mapping, owner + on-call). Rows flagged "customer-action" indicate controls that require Horizon tenant configuration (e.g., tenant-level encryption keys).
- kv_cache_sample.log: 120-line extract showing anonymized cache hits/misses, timestamped request ids, and a small latency table at the end. All identifiers replaced with stable hashes; no PII.
- README_DRIVE.txt (in Drive link): explains sampling method, log retention window, and where to find runtime tracing for Hosted vs Dedicated.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNaomi-Horizon-CAIQ (access: viewers added for susan.leung@horizonfin.com and alex.montgomery@auditfirm.com)
DocuSign for evidence acceptance (if needed): https://www.docusign.com/EnvelopeDetail?envelopeId=abc123

If you want a short walkthrough, Naomi and I can set up a 30-minute sync — propose 7/1 10:00am PT.
